directive.quote: Port handleConnectStart (PKCE S256, state stored, 302 to provider) and handleConnectCallback (code exchange, token kept) one to one; all connected-services work lives in Workshop tools, used through the door.

old_copy.deleted_with: old trillion retired the Worker after tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire: the file is no longer on its main line

targets.baseline_commit_message: Byte copy of the old sign-in start (src/connect.mjs lines 473-484) and the token requests a sign-in callback makes

preserve: the start makes a random state and, when the service asks for PKCE, a verifier whose S256 challenge goes to the service; the verifier waits with the state for the callback

the sign-in address is the descriptor's authorize_url with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type code, the descriptor's scopes joined by its scope_separator, the state, the challenge and the descriptor's auth_params
the client id is the sign-in app's id as the account holds it in the open, never a vault value

the callback finds the saved state by its digest and removes it before anything else, so a state is used once; an unknown or expired state, a service error, a missing code or a service that no longer matches answers that nothing was saved
the code is traded for the tokens with the sign-in app's id and secret placed only as the request leaves, and the tokens are kept sealed, never shown
allowed_deltas: the request comes as the @workshop-routes input { path, method, query, account_id } and the answer is { status, body }; the engine lets no route tool answer a redirect (trillion-rust src/server/tool_http_response.rs), so the start answers the sign-in address for the page or AI to open
the state waits as a service-connection-pending record of the person (its id the state digest, with an expiry), not in the Worker KV
the code exchange and every following exchange are the http rows of this folder, which keep the tokens in the vault as the new connection's fields (reply_holds_values), not the old store box
the connection is one service-connection row of list:service-connections written once with the starting values the start was given
a reconnect is a new sign-in and a new row; the old row is retired by its Status
banned_substitutions: a token, code verifier or client secret in a run answer, a log line or a record other than the pending one
a second copy of the service descriptors
